summary: Post-initialization pass run after a scene load for a vehicle. Resets field 0x124 to the float -1.0 (packet literal 18446744072627421184 / -1082130432) as a disabled sentinel, calls CUBESceneLoaderEntry() and FieldSetterCall(2), runs two update helpers sub_466350 and sub_466650 on this, then conditionally calls sub_541CA0(1) when the flag at field 0xEC is non-zero. Always returns 0.

local_names.this: vehicle scene state object; flag at 0xEC gates the extra init call

operations.description: Write this[73] = -1082130432, the bit pattern of -1.0f, to field 0x124; used as a disabled/reset sentinel
CUBESceneLoaderEntry() invoked with no arguments as part of post-load scene wiring
FieldSetterCall(2) sets a field/state with literal argument 2
sub_466350(this) runs a position/velocity update helper on the scene state object
sub_466650(this) runs a secondary physics/state update helper on the scene state object
Read flag at this[59] (field 0xEC); if non-zero the conditional init below runs, otherwise it is skipped
sub_541CA0(1) extra initialization called only when the flag at field 0xEC is set; argument 1
Return 0 (success indicator); invoked by VehicleSceneLoadAndPositionTires (004681B0) during vehicle scene setup
